title: Implement unit conversion helpers per K.5
description:
Add unit conversion inline functions or macros to gatt_ipso.h:

Per K.5 conversions:
1. gatt_mmhg_to_pa(float mmhg) -> Pa: x 133.322
2. gatt_fahrenheit_to_cel(float f) -> Cel: (f - 32) * 5/9
3. gatt_mgdl_to_kgl(float mgdl) -> kg/L: x 1e-5
4. gatt_lbs_to_kg(float lbs) -> kg: x 0.453592
5. gatt_feet_to_m(float ft) -> m: x 0.3048
6. gatt_mph_to_ms(float mph) -> m/s: x 0.44704
7. gatt_centideg_to_deg(int16_t cdeg) -> deg: / 100.0
8. gatt_1024deg_to_deg(int32_t deg1024) -> deg: / 1024.0

rpm and bpm are identity (same as /min).

~40 LOC. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.5
